🤖 Tired of isolated AI tools that can't scale beyond a local CLI? Meet Hermes Agent by Nous Research—a self-improving autonomous AI agent framework designed to bridge the gap between simple local scripts and production-grade, distributed workflows.

Hermes Agent solves the problem of agentic fragmentation by offering a unified gateway across multiple messaging platforms and terminal backends, all while maintaining a closed learning loop where the agent actually creates, uses, and self-improves its own skills from real operational experience.

🔥 Notable Features:
• Closed learning loop featuring autonomous skill creation, agent-curated memory, and FTS5 session search compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
• Cross-platform gateway supporting Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI with unified conversation continuity and voice memo transcription.
• Multi-backend execution scaling effortlessly from a $5 VPS to serverless environments like Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox.
• Model-agnostic architecture allowing instant switching between Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and custom endpoints with zero code changes.

Whether you are automating multi-step DevOps workflows, scheduling server maintenance tasks via cron prompts, or building trajectory generation pipelines to fine-tune custom LLMs, Hermes Agent gives you a production-ready setup with zero vendor lock-in.

👉 Check it out on GitHub and start building:
https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

Building safe, transaction-heavy AI agents for production just got a whole lot easier. 🚀

Anthropic just dropped `anthropics/commerce-agents`, a production-ready reference blueprint featuring dual agents designed for high-stakes retail, travel, telecom, and entertainment environments.

🛑 The Problem:
Deploying LLM agents in commerce environments is risky. Without rigid boundaries, hallucinations lead to unauthorized purchases, incorrect pricing updates, and broken state management. Developers waste countless hours building custom guardrails, session managers, and security layers from scratch.

💡 What It Solves:
This repository provides a complete, enterprise-grade architecture for two distinct AI commerce roles: a customer-facing shopping agent and a staff-facing merchant agent. It bakes in critical safeguards like state staging, human-in-the-loop approval gates for writes, strict tool fencing, and memory validation using the Anthropic Messages API, the Claude Agent SDK, and Managed Agents.

✨ Key Features:
• Dual-Agent Architecture: Specialized shopping and merchant agent roles sharing a unified core framework.
• Multi-Runtime Flexibility: Deploy across the reference Messages API, local Claude Agent SDK, and hosted Managed Agents via MCP servers.
• Enterprise Safety & Provenance Gates: Built-in state staging (all merchant writes held pending human approval), tool fencing, and safety guardrails.
• Cross-Vertical Scaffolding: Runnable multi-vertical demos (retail, travel, telecom, entertainment) plus a Claude Code plugin (`commerce-builder`) to rapidly scaffold or audit custom implementations.
• Clean Backend Interfaces: `StorefrontBackend` and `MerchantBackend` patterns to securely integrate existing enterprise data warehouses, e-commerce platforms, and CRMs.

Whether you are embedding an intelligent shopping assistant into a web app or automating back-office merchant workflows with mandatory approval gates, this repo saves you from trial-and-error engineering.

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/anthropics/commerce-agents

Stop guessing if ChatGPT actually recommends your product. Traditional SEO is shifting toward AI search and recommendation systems, but growth teams and developers lack programmatic visibility into how Large Language Models position their brand.

Meet NiubiGEO: an open-source GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI visibility tracking tool. It allows you to input a domain and audit how various AI models perceive your product, what competitor products they associate with it, which keywords trigger mentions, and what sources they rely on.

Here is what you get out of the box:

* Multi-Model Comparison via OpenRouter: Compare how different AI models describe your brand, categorize your product, and surface competitors side-by-side.
* Web Search Integration Toggle: Test model responses with native web search enabled or offline to capture exact execution conditions and provider citations.
* Keyword & Competitor Intelligence: Run targeted keyword tests without naming your brand to see who unprompted AI systems recommend instead.
* Scheduled Monitoring & Historical Tracking: Set up scheduled runs using Docker to track historical changes in brand visibility over time.

Whether you are auditing your SaaS product against top competitors or measuring how recent documentation updates impact AI recommendations, NiubiGEO gives you the self-hosted black-box reporting tool you need to optimize for AI retrieval.

Check out the repo and start tracking your AI brand visibility today:
https://github.com/Albert-Weasker/niubigeo

Stop guessing where your Mac's SSD space went—this lightweight SwiftUI menu bar app finally opens up the opaque 'System Data' black hole. 🕳️💻

We've all been there: macOS suddenly claims you have 100GB+ trapped in a mysterious 'System Data' bucket. Between bloated Xcode DerivedData, forgotten iOS simulators, endless Docker layers, and heavy package manager caches, your local development toolchain is quietly eating your expensive SSD alive. And macOS gives you zero native tools to actually inspect or safely clean it. 

Enter Jarvis322/macos-sysdata: a native, high-performance SwiftUI menu bar utility designed specifically for developers to scan, measure, categorize, and granularly delete these hidden space hogs item by item. 🚀

Here is why you need this on your Mac right now:

🔍 Transparent Size Measurement & Safety Badging: Measures exact on-disk footprints for roughly 180 items across 18 groups, tagging them intelligently as Safe (auto-regenerable), Review (costs something to remove), or Manual.

🗑️ Smart Deletion & Audit Controls: Sends review items safely to the Trash while outright purging safe caches, complete with local history tracking to monitor growth trends over time.

🛡️ Root Transparency & Safety First: No blind background scripts here. Every administrative action displays the exact osascript or rm -rf command verbatim for your review before a single byte is touched.

⚡ Power-User Extensibility & CLI Support: Includes a CLI flag (SysDataMenu --json) to pipe inventories into custom scripting, plus clever performance tweaks like pre-emptively shutting down booted iOS simulators to speed up your workflow.

Whether you want to automate local disk hygiene scripts via CI/CD or instantly reclaim dozens of gigabytes eaten up by stale mobile runtimes without breaking your dev environment, this tool is an absolute must-have for your menu bar. 

Check out the code, drop a star, and reclaim your storage today:
https://github.com/Jarvis322/macos-sysdata

Tired of wrestling with fragmented Polymarket data and heavy database servers just to run a simple SQL query? 

Meet PolyLedger (https://github.com/nahrek/polyledger)—a resilient, DuckDB-backed indexer that turns high-volume Polymarket CLOB metadata and Polygon on-chain trades into queryable SQL tables in a single file. 🚀

The Problem:
Analyzing decentralized prediction market data is notoriously painful. You have to stitch together raw Polygon logs, parse complex EVM event variants across both V1 and V2 contracts, fight API rate limits, and figure out tricky price math and token-id gap recovery. 

How PolyLedger Solves It:
PolyLedger syncs market data from REST APIs and streams OrderFilled events from Polygon using Envio HyperSync. It handles the heavy lifting of ingestion and stores everything inside a zero-server DuckDB file for immediate local analytics.

Key Features & Developer Value:
• Embedded Columnar Analytics: Ditch the traditional database overhead. PolyLedger stores data in a single DuckDB file with advanced columnar compression and real types.
• Resumable & Idempotent Architecture: Rows and block cursors commit in a single transaction with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING keys, making re-running ranges safe.
• Comprehensive Dual-Contract Support: Natively decodes both legacy V1 and modern V2 exchange layouts, maintaining separate checkpoints per stream.
• Robust API Resilience: Features exponential backoff, rate-limiting, Pydantic schema validation, and automated fallback to the Gamma API.

Save hundreds of hours of custom data-pipelining work. Whether you are building trading bots, tracking whale positions, computing VWAP, or feeding clean Parquet exports directly into Pandas, Polars, or Spark for quantitative backtesting, PolyLedger gets you straight to the data. 📈
